title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
Luxon TATA is an authorized TATA Motors dealership providing a range of Tata vehicles to customers in Kerala. The dealership focuses on delivering reliable automotive solutions supported by professional sales and service teams. Luxon TATA emphasizes customer satisfaction through efficient processes and attentive support. Team members work in a structured, fast-paced environment with opportunities to contribute to both administrative and customer-facing operations. The organization values accuracy, integrity, and collaboration in all aspects of its business.

**Role Description**
The Data Entry Specialist is a full-time, on-site role based in Irumpanam. This role is responsible for accurately entering, dms report to sales heads, updating, and maintaining customer, vehicle, and transaction data in dealership systems. Day-to-day tasks include verifying documents, checking data for completeness and accuracy, and organizing electronic and paper records. The specialist collaborates with sales and service teams to ensure timely data entry that supports billing, inventory tracking, and reporting. The role may also involve basic administrative support such as preparing simple reports, responding to internal information requests, and assisting with front-office documentation.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Typing skills and solid Computer Literacy for efficient and accurate data entry.
* Candidates should possess clear Communication skills and a customer-focused approach when interacting with internal teams and customers.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service capabilities to support a positive dealership experience during data and document handling.
* Candidates should possess Administrative Assistance skills, including organizing records and supporting routine office tasks.
* Attention to detail, reliability, and the ability to manage repetitive tasks with consistency.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced dealership environment and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Prior experience in data entry, office administration, or automotive retail is an advantage.
* Basic educational qualification such as a high school diploma or equivalent; additional certifications in computer applications are a plus.
